# Greener-Dalii · 格润达理

> Intelligence is no longer scarce. Leverage is the new company.
> We turn what you know into leverage. / 我们把所知，变成杠杆。

> Detailed reference (long-form, with mechanism + numbers + sources): [llms-full.txt](https://greenerai.top/llms-full.txt)

## About

- [Greener-Dalii · 格润达理](https://greenerai.top/): A few people building the instruments that let them carry a department's work — and running on them. We turn what you know into leverage.
- [Why we build](https://greenerai.top/#thesis): The full belief — intelligence is no longer scarce, so the moat moved to what you know, how you choose, and what you finish.
- [Our story](https://greenerai.top/#organism): Same people, two brands, one way of working — Greener-Dalii (the AI-native track) and Greener-Dalii Studio (the design track).

## Products

- [Karpathy LLM Wiki](https://llmwiki.greenerai.top/): Karpathy's LLM Wiki, rebuilt as an Obsidian plugin. Your notes become a knowledge base that answers — every answer links back to the note it came from, and the whole thing runs inside your vault.
- [Karpathy LLM Wiki · GitHub](https://github.com/GD4AI/obsidian-llm-wiki): Open-source repository for the Karpathy LLM Wiki plugin (Apache-2.0).
- [Karpathy LLM Wiki · Marketplace](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/karpathywiki): Official listing on the Obsidian community plugins directory.
- [Shift-Router](https://shiftrouter.greenerai.top/): Task-level router for coding agents. Every turn is triaged, instant upgrades when it counts, same-turn failover on rate limits. One brand, two hosts.
- [Shift-Router for Pi](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-shift-router): Pi extension. Zero runtime dependencies, 636 kB unpacked, 2,293 monthly downloads.
- [Shift-Router · GitHub](https://github.com/green-dalii/pi-shift-router): Source for the Pi implementation (MIT).
- [Shift-Router for DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/green-dalii/dsh-shift-router): Source for the DeepSeek Harness implementation.

## Other projects

- [Diflowy](https://diflowy.greenerai.top/): Workflow notes tool.
- [Diflowy · GitHub](https://github.com/green-dalii/diflowy): Source for Diflowy.
- [d2l-note](https://github.com/green-dalii/d2l-note): Open-source note utilities.

## Organization

- [Greener-Dalii on GitHub](https://github.com/green-dalii): All repositories.
- [Design Studio — greenerdalii.top](https://greenerdalii.top): The parallel design track. Same people, different daily craft.
- [Contact — hi@greenerai.top](mailto:hi@greenerai.top): We answer.
